context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves account data with filters like username patterns and return fields. Currency is stored as a standard field on user profiles. Test accounts in the system often have descriptive usernames indicating their purpose (e.g., "eur_currency_agent"). The function returns paginated results with a default limit that can be adjusted.
